Convert a decimal number to binary and back.

Supplied answer
n = int(input("Enter a decimal number: "))
binary = ""
temp = n
while temp > 0:
    binary = str(temp % 2) + binary # add the new bit in front
    temp //= 2
print("Binary =", binary or "0")
print("Built-in :", bin(n)[2:])
print("Back to decimal :", int(binary, 2))
Note: bin() returns a string like '0b101', so [2:] removes the prefix. int(s, 2) converts back.
